def subgroup_comap_equiv_3 {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (ϕ : G ≃* G) :
  Subgroup.comap ϕ.toMonoidHom H ≃ H := by
  fconstructor
  · intro x
    exact ⟨ϕ x.1, x.2⟩
  · intro y
    refine ⟨ϕ.symm y.1, ?_⟩
    change ϕ (ϕ.symm y.1) ∈ H
    rw [ϕ.apply_symm_apply]
    exact y.2
  · intro x
    ext
    exact ϕ.symm_apply_apply x.1
  · intro y
    ext
    exact ϕ.apply_symm_apply y.1

lemma card_comap_equiv_6 {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (ϕ : G ≃* G) [Fintype (Subgroup.comap ϕ.toMonoidHom H)] :
  Fintype.card (Subgroup.comap ϕ.toMonoidHom H) = Fintype.card H := by
  exact Fintype.card_congr (subgroup_comap_equiv_3 H ϕ)

lemma comm_of_eigenvector {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F]
  [Module F V] [FiniteDimensional F V] {S T : Module.End F V}
  (h2 : ∀ v : V, ∃ c : F, v ∈ Module.End.eigenspace S c ↔ ∃ c : F, v ∈ Module.End.eigenspace T c)
  (v : V) (hv : ∃ c : F, v ∈ Module.End.eigenspace T c) :
  S (T v) = T (S v) := by
  rcases hv with ⟨cT, hcT⟩
  rcases h2 v with ⟨cS, hcS⟩
  have h_mem_S : v ∈ Module.End.eigenspace S cS := hcS.mpr ⟨cT, hcT⟩
  rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff] at hcT h_mem_S
  rw [hcT, h_mem_S]
  rw [map_smul, map_smul]
  rw [hcT, h_mem_S]
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm]
